title: Block Selected iPhone Apps Until 8 a.m.
description: Set a fixed morning schedule for a short list of distracting iPhone apps. Check both ends of the block and keep essential apps available.
direct: Use a recurring rule with a fixed morning start and end to block only the apps you select. Set the end to 8 a.m. if that is when you want access again.
figureAlt: A nightstand with a phone face down beside a clock reading eight, in morning light.
figureCaption: AI illustration of a fixed morning cutoff.
cards.decision.heading: Use a clock window
cards.decision.body: A daily usage allowance counts minutes. A morning schedule uses set times. If the problem starts when you first pick up the phone, choose a start time earlier than that pickup.
sections.detail-1.heading: If your wake time changes
sections.detail-1.body: The rule uses a clock and the days you set. It does not know when you woke up. For a one-off session, Block Now runs for 30 minutes. If your routine varies by day, check each scheduled window separately.
sections.detail-2.heading: Set a manageable first rule
sections.detail-2.body: Space Sheep Studio develops Dying Soon for iPhone. One scheduled rule is free. Temporary unlocks of 5, 15 or 30 minutes are available. Start with the small list that causes the problem. If you also want to block the same apps at night, check what happens around midnight and when the morning rule ends.

sources.store.label: Dying Soon: Screen Time Limit 2.3.4 on the App Store
related.related.label: Related practical guide
steps.step-1.text: Write down the apps you want to avoid before 8 a.m. Keep your alarm, calls, maps and any other essentials outside the list.
steps.step-2.text: In Dying Soon: Screen Time Limit, grant the requested Screen Time access and select the distracting apps. Set a recurring rule for the chosen morning hours. Check the selected days before you save it.
steps.step-3.text: Test a temporary window during the day first. Try one selected app and one essential app. Then check that the selected app opens again when the window ends.
